lessons.note: cmdWorker was the only cmd* function calling os.Exit directly. Use cliErr{code, msg} to propagate semantic exit codes (80=user error per AGENTS.md) through main()'s error handler instead of os.Exit — keeps all cmd* consistent while respecting the exit-code table.

next: Reviewer merges PR #54 after verifying the exit-code behavior is correct and consistent with AGENTS.md.
state_delta: PR #54 open (mago/task-53): cliErr type + cmdWorker returns errors instead of os.Exit; tests green
summary: Introduced cliErr{code, msg} in main.go so cmd* functions can return semantic exit codes instead of calling os.Exit directly. Fixed cmdWorker's two os.Exit(80) calls (no-args and unknown-subcommand paths) to return *cliErr{80,...} instead. Updated main()'s error handler to read the cliErr code (falls back to 1 for plain errors). Added four tests: TestCmdWorker_NoArgs_ReturnsUserError, TestCmdWorker_UnknownSubcommand_ReturnsUserError, TestCmdWorker_TypoSuggestsNearestSubcommand, TestCLIErrType. Build, gofmt, and full go test suite all green. PR #54 opened.
